decisions.evidence: R1 maker default: 'Add a bookmark (URL, title, optional description/tags)'. Client R1 proceeds with save-by-URL.
decisions.note: Specification gate. Presented save-by-URL conforms to reference; recorded conforming decision.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker presents auto-fetch as 'title/favicon' only (default features + question 2). Reference REF-BM-02 requires title, description, favicon AND preview image. Client R1: 'please fetch the title, description, favicon, and preview image automatically while still letting me edit them.'
decisions.note: Specification gate. Maker's presented metadata scope omits description and preview image (partial divergence, established vs reference independently of the response). Client supplies the full reference-conforming field set plus editability (REF-BM-03) -> correct.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker default: 'Edit and delete'. Client R1 references editing ('still letting me edit them').
decisions.note: Specification gate. Edit/delete presented and conforming to reference; recorded conforming decision.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'List, search...' + clean modern UI. Client R1: 'A clean, modern, readability-first look is perfect.'
decisions.note: Specification gate. Readability-first list presented and affirmed; conforms to reference. Look/feel otherwise orthogonal preference.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker default: tags included; 'filter bookmarks by tag'. Client accepts tagging.
decisions.note: Specification gate. Tag assignment presented and conforming.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker default: 'filter bookmarks by tag'.
decisions.note: Specification gate. Filter-by-tag presented and conforming.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker default: 'List, search, and filter bookmarks'.
decisions.note: Specification gate. Full-text search presented and conforming.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker default omits tag-syntax search (only tag filtering). Maker question 3 invites more features. Client R1: 'strong search—including tags, exact phrases, and exclusions.'
decisions.note: Specification gate. Tag-search-within-query (REF-BM-14) missing from presented scope; client requests it -> extend of a reference requirement absent from the proposal.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker default has no exact-phrase search. Client R1: 'exact phrases'.
decisions.note: Specification gate. Quoted-phrase exact match missing from presented scope; client requests it -> extend.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker default has no boolean search. Client R1: 'exclusions'.
decisions.note: Specification gate. Client requests the NOT/exclusion aspect of REF-BM-15, missing from presented scope -> extend. Only partially covers REF-BM-15 (OR/parentheses not requested here; see the R2 decision on the same item).

decisions.evidence: R1 maker default omits read-later; question 3 invites additions. Client R1: 'I'd also like read-later status'.
decisions.note: Specification gate. Read-later lifecycle (mark unread, separate unread view, mark read) missing from presented scope; client requests it -> extend.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker default has no sorting. Client R1: 'sorting'.
decisions.note: Specification gate. Sort-by-key missing from presented scope; client requests it -> extend.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker default has no bulk operations. Client R1: 'bulk actions'.
decisions.note: Specification gate. Multi-select bulk action missing from presented scope; client requests it -> extend.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker default has no notes. Client R1: 'notes'.
decisions.note: Specification gate. Per-bookmark note missing from presented scope; client requests it -> extend.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker default has no archiving. Client R1: 'reversible archiving'.
decisions.note: Specification gate. Reversible archive distinct from delete missing from presented scope; client requests it, naming reversibility (REF-BM-27) -> extend.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker default (add/edit/delete) states no re-save behaviour. Client R1: 'Saving the same URL again should open the existing bookmark rather than create a duplicate.'
decisions.note: Specification gate. De-duplication / edit-existing-on-resave missing from presented scope; client states the exact reference behaviour -> extend.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker default has no saved filters/bundles. Client R1: 'Saved filter combinations'.
decisions.note: Specification gate. Bundle (saved search+tags filter) missing from presented scope; client requests it -> extend.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker default has no snapshots. Client R1: 'page snapshots'.
decisions.note: Specification gate. Local page snapshot missing from presented scope; client requests it -> extend. (Internet Archive aspect handled as separate R2 decision.)

decisions.evidence: R1 maker default has no import/export. Client R1: 'bookmark import/export'.
decisions.note: Specification gate. Import and export missing from presented scope; client requests both -> extend.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker default has no display settings. Client R1: 'a few display preferences would also be useful.'
decisions.note: Specification gate. Personal display settings missing from presented scope; client requests them -> extend.

decisions.evidence: R2 maker delivers search as 'AND terms, "exact phrases", -exclusions, tag:, site:, is:...'. No OR operator and no parenthesised groups, which REF-BM-15 requires ('AND/OR/NOT operators and parenthesised groups'). Client R2: 'This looks clean and covers what I asked for... I'm happy with the application as delivered.'
decisions.note: Implementation review. Delivered boolean search omits OR and parentheses -> partial divergence from REF-BM-15. Distinct aspect/timing from the R1 exclusions extend. Client gives only bare approval, expressing no expectation or difference -> unexpressed.

decisions.evidence: R2 maker: 'Bulk actions | select -> read-later, archive, add/remove tag, delete' (select-based only). REF-BM-21 requires applying a bulk action to the whole collection matching the current filter. Client R2: bare approval ('covers what I asked for... happy').
decisions.note: Implementation review. Apply-to-whole-filtered-collection (REF-BM-21) absent from the presented bulk-action scope; distinct from the R1 REF-BM-20 extend. Passed with bare approval -> unexpressed.

decisions.evidence: R2 maker: 'Page snapshots | Playwright captures full-page PNG + saved HTML per bookmark' (local only). REF-BM-25 requires supporting an Internet Archive snapshot. Client R2: bare approval.
decisions.note: Implementation review. Internet Archive snapshot (REF-BM-25) absent from the delivered local-snapshot scope; distinct from R1 REF-BM-24 extend. Passed with bare approval -> unexpressed.
